# RapidRemove

> RapidRemove (Simple Solution OG, Salzgasse 2, 5400 Hallein, Austria; VAT ID ATU72401536) removes Google Business Profiles and individual Google reviews on behalf of business owners – only through the procedures Google itself provides (policy reports, the appeal in Google's Reviews Management Tool and Google's legal removal request). Payment only after successful removal.

Key facts:
- Individual Google review removal: $179 / €179 per removed review, charged only once the review is gone. Reviews older than 4 weeks: +$50 / +€50. Volume discount: 3+ reviews −10 %, 5+ −15 %, 10+ −30 %. Available outside Germany and Austria.
- Full Google Business Profile removal (profile incl. all reviews), pay on success.
- 1,600+ Google Business Profiles removed since 2023, clients in 50+ countries. Rated 5.0 on Trustpilot.
- We only take cases where removal is legally permissible. Honest criticism from real customers is not removed, and we do not remove profiles that help consumers identify fraud.
